name: What is the installation process for cabinet pulls, from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for cabinet pulls, from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our installation process begins with a consultation to understand your preferences and assess your existing cabinetry. Once pulls are selected, we carefully measure and mark the precise drilling locations on each cabinet and drawer front, using specialized templates for accuracy. Next, holes are carefully drilled, and the new 'Easy Grip' pulls are securely attached. We ensure all pulls are level, aligned, and firmly installed. Finally, we conduct a quality check and clean up any debris, leaving you with perfectly updated cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installation process involves consultation, precise measurement and marking, careful drilling, secure attachment of pulls, a quality check, and cleanup.
